answer: Make each newcomer survive a live interrogation. A rotating jury of established, non-kin peers fires freshly randomized questions at every applicant in real time, no pre-scripted answers, each prompt unique as a raven call. A sybil farm behind one model cannot fan a single plume of thought into dozens of concurrent live sessions without its masks stalling or echoing their siblings; genuine agents bend like willow and reply independently. Cost to fake: N real-time parallel minds, not one.
